articles.title: Why Has Japan Struggled to Build Global-Scale Biotech Companies?
articles.summary: Japan has strong science, major pharmaceutical companies, and a large drug market. The harder question is why that foundation has not produced more global-scale biotech startups. The answer is not scientific weakness, but an ecosystem gap across assets, talent, capital, clinical execution, and exits.

articles.title: Off-the-Shelf CAR-T in 2026: Rebounding From the Trough
articles.summary: Off-the-shelf allogeneic CAR-T is no longer just a beautiful manufacturing story. In 2026, better clinical signals and clearer positioning are bringing the field back to the table.

articles.title: Big Pharma's $134 Billion M&A Rush: What Is It Really Buying?
articles.summary: In the first half of 2026, Big Pharma's biotech M&A pace has accelerated sharply. The real question is not why large drugmakers have cash, but why they are suddenly less willing to wait.

articles.title: Operation TrialBlazer: Why HHS Is Rewriting Clinical-Trial Rules and Biotech Competition
articles.summary: Operation TrialBlazer is not just an FDA efficiency program. It signals that the United States is treating clinical-trial speed as part of national biotech competitiveness, with direct implications for biotech valuation, financing windows, and regulatory strategy.

articles.title: Centanafadine’s Phase 3b Win: Why ADHD Treatment Is Moving Beyond Discipline and Toward Neurobiology
articles.summary: Otsuka’s centanafadine has reported positive Phase 3b data in adults with ADHD and comorbid anxiety. The FDA has accepted the NDA and granted priority review, making the program a useful lens for how ADHD treatment is shifting from behavioral stigma toward more precise neurobiological intervention.

articles.title: Is the First AI-Designed Drug Finally Arriving? Takeda's Zasocitinib Beats Sotyktu Head-to-Head
articles.summary: Takeda's zasocitinib beat Sotyktu in a head-to-head Phase 3 psoriasis study, turning AI-enabled drug design into a real commercial test.

articles.title: 日本為什麼長不出全球級 Biotech？問題不在科學，而在產業生態
articles.summary: 日本不是缺少科學，也不是缺少大藥廠，而是缺少把大學技術、人才、資本、臨床與 BD 串成全球級 Biotech 的連續生態。

articles.title: GLP-1's Second Half: Why Dorzagliatin Is About Making Metabolic Therapy Last
articles.summary: GLP-1 competition is moving from peak weight loss toward long-term use, tolerability, rebound control, and combination design. Dorzagliatin matters not as a GLP-1 replacement, but as a possible metabolic base for the next phase of chronic therapy.

articles.title: GLP-1 下半場：dorzagliatin（多格列艾汀）想解決的，不是減重更猛，而是長期用得住
articles.summary: GLP-1 競爭進入長期維持與聯用下半場，dorzagliatin 的價值不在取代減重藥，而是可能成為代謝治療的可持續底座。

articles.title: Tirzepatide Enters Autoimmune Disease: Is Immunometabolism Lilly's Next Expansion Path?
articles.summary: Lilly is testing whether tirzepatide can move beyond weight loss and become part of an immunometabolism strategy for chronic immune-inflammatory diseases.

articles.title: 神藥 猛健樂 Tirzepatide 進軍自體免疫，只差臨門一腳？
articles.summary: 它不像急性感染，用藥幾天或幾週就結束。類風濕性關節炎、乾癬、乾癬性關節炎、發炎性腸道疾病、氣喘、異位性皮膚炎，這些疾病往往跟著患者一輩子。

articles.title: Pfizer's ADC Bet: Why 3SBio's PD-1/VEGF Bispecific Has Become the New Pivot
articles.summary: After a Phase III setback for sigvotatug vedotin, Pfizer's $43 billion Seagen ADC bet is increasingly tied to whether 3SBio's PD-1/VEGF bispecific can become a new immuno-oncology combination backbone.

articles.title: 【輝瑞 ADC 賭局：430 億美元買下 Seagen 之後，為什麼 3SBio 的 PD-1/VEGF 雙抗變成新支點？】
articles.summary: sigvotatug vedotin Phase III 單藥失利後，輝瑞的 430 億美元 Seagen ADC 賭局正轉向 3SBio PD-1/VEGF 雙抗與聯合療法底座。

articles.title: RevMed Says No to Being Bought: Biotech's Independent Era
articles.summary: Revolution Medicines is choosing not to make a sale its priority. The decision reflects a broader shift: top-tier biotech companies with breakthrough assets may once again have a credible path to grow into independent biopharma companies.

articles.title: Synthetic Lethality After PARP: Why the Next Oncology Blockbuster Has Been So Hard to Find
articles.summary: PARP inhibitors turned synthetic lethality into a commercial reality. Two decades later, the industry is still asking why the next PARP-like blockbuster has been so difficult to reproduce.

articles.title: GSK Goes Big: The $10.6B Nuvalent Deal Is Not Just a Lung-Cancer Pipeline Buy
articles.summary: GSK's $10.6 billion all-cash acquisition of Nuvalent is more than a late-stage lung-cancer pipeline deal. It is a strategic attempt to rebuild oncology, buy time before major revenue pressure, and regain a seat at the precision-oncology table.

articles.title: GSK 上強度：106 億美元買下 Nuvalent，不只是補肺癌管線，而是重返腫瘤牌桌
articles.summary: 2026 年 6 月，GSK 宣布以 106 億美元全現金收購 Nuvalent，收購價格為每股 124 美元。這筆交易不是小修小補，而是新任 CEO Luke Miels 上任後，替 GSK 腫瘤版圖打下的一記重拳。

articles.title: Pancreatic Cancer Breakthrough: After RAS Inhibitors, PRMT5/MAT2A Combinations Open the Next Layer of Upside
articles.summary: Pancreatic cancer is moving into a new phase of precision combination therapy, as RAS inhibition meets MTAP-selective PRMT5 and MAT2A strategies.

articles.title: 胰臟癌再爆：RAS 抑制劑之後，PRMT5／MAT2A 聯合療法把想像空間再打開
articles.summary: 胰臟癌正在進入 RAS 抑制劑與 PRMT5／MAT2A 合成致死聯合療法的新階段，市場開始重新評估 daraxonrasib 作為治療骨架的價值。

articles.title: 通用型 CAR-T 的 2026 從低谷回暖
articles.summary: 邏輯很簡單：傳統自體 CAR-T 需要取出患者自己的 T 細胞，送到工廠改造、擴增、檢驗，再回輸到患者體內。療效可以很強，但等待時間長、成本高、製程複雜，病情進展太快或 T 細胞品質太差的患者，常常等不到治療。

articles.title: 摒棄「鐵拳教育」：ADHD 新藥 centanafadine IIIb 期成功，上市只差臨門一腳
articles.summary: Otsuka 的 ADHD 新藥 centanafadine 公布成人 ADHD 合併焦慮症 IIIb 期積極結果，FDA 已接受 NDA 並給予優先審查。這不只是新藥進度，也反映 ADHD 治療正在從單一路徑走向更多機制與病人分層。

articles.title: 美股迎來史上最大 Biotech IPO
articles.summary: 台股生技板塊還在低谷裡掙扎，美股生技市場卻突然打出一個極端反差。

articles.title: 半年併購 1,340 億美元：Big Pharma 到底在搶什麼？
articles.summary: 2026 年才過一半，全球製藥業的併購節奏已經快到讓人有點恍神。

articles.title: 美國 HHS 啟動 Operation TrialBlazer：臨床試驗規則要變了，新藥競爭也要變了
articles.summary: 2026 年 6 月 22 日，美國衛生與公共服務部，也就是 HHS，啟動了一項名為 Operation TrialBlazer 的部門級臨床試驗改革計畫。

articles.title: 拒絕被併購的 RevMed：Biotech 的獨立時代
articles.summary: 圍繞 Revolution Medicines（RevMed）的併購傳聞，一直沒有真正停過。

articles.title: 合成致死二十年：為什麼 PARP 之後，下一個神藥遲遲沒有出現？
articles.summary: 2005 年，《Nature》兩篇經典研究把 BRCA／PARP 這組關係推上舞台。

articles.title: The FDA Tone Has Shifted: Why Biotech’s Rebound Is Starting at the Regulatory Layer
articles.summary: Biotech’s recent rebound is not only a risk-on trade. FDA review signals, rare-disease flexibility, mRNA vaccine momentum, and renewed pharma M&A are changing how investors price clinical-stage assets.

articles.title: FDA 風向變了：Biotech 反攻訊號，正在從監管端亮起
articles.summary: 代表中小型 Biotech 的 XBI（SPDR S&P Biotech ETF）近期走勢強勁，資金也重新流入。照理說，在利率仍未完全放鬆、風險資產仍會被折現率壓制的環境下，高波動的 Biotech 不應該是最輕鬆的族群。

articles.title: The Largest Biotech IPO in US Market History: What Parabilis Is Really Teaching Investors
articles.summary: Parabilis Medicines' record-setting US biotech IPO is not a sign that speculative biotech is back. It shows that investors are willing to fund high-risk innovation when the platform, clinical asset, external validation, and capital-market window all line up.

articles.title: 邁向「寵物醫療界羅氏」的寶泰生醫
articles.summary: 當毛孩高齡化趨勢推動癌症、心臟病與自體免疫等重症治療的需求升級，市場的長期觀察核心，在於誰能率先打造一座寵物重症新藥平台，成為『寵物醫療界羅氏』。而這一改寫行業格局的答案，正於台灣的一家生技公司加速浮現。
